deck_metadata.title: Gridpunk Arcana
deck_metadata.theme_overarching: The Cyber-Shamanic Matrix — A reality where the digital ether (the Grid) and the spiritual plane have seamlessly merged. Hackers act as modern shamans navigating neon-lit data streams, megacorps are the ruling pantheon, and AI constructs hold the secrets of archetypal consciousness. Magic is data; data is power.

physical_specs.size: Standard Tarot (2.75" x 4.75") to maintain traditional handling, but printed on high-density ultra-slick synthetic polymer.
physical_specs.edges: Holographic Cyan-Magenta foil edges that glow under UV light.
physical_specs.style: High-contrast neon over abyssal voids (Vantablack backgrounds). The imagery blends glitch-art, circuit board tracery, and sacred geometry. Holographic foil selectively highlights key ethereal symbols on the cards.

Sparks.theme: Pure energy, passion, willpower, and the spark of creation. Symbolizes the rebellious street hackers, neural-interface runners, and bursts of untamed data.
Sparks.visual_motif: Neon orange and heavy red tones. Glowing electric arcs, fiber optic cables, and kinetic motion.

Vials.theme: Emotion, connection, biotech, and synthetic feelings. Symbolizes the bio-engineers, underground clinics, chemical enhancements, and the fluid nature of human empathy in a metal world.
Vials.visual_motif: Deep cyan and bioluminescent blues. Glowing liquid serums, medical tubes, rainy neon reflections, and glass.

Blades.theme: Intellect, conflict, truth, and corporate warfare. Symbolizes the cutthroat logic of megacorporations, AI security systems (ICE), assassins, and the painful severance of truth.
Blades.visual_motif: Harsh magenta and sterile white. Monomolecular edges, lasers, sharp geometric angles, and shattered glass.

Chips.theme: Material wealth, hardware, crypto-credits, and physical bodies. Symbolizes terrestrial resources, server farms, cybernetic augmentations, and the tangible foundations of the Grid.
Chips.visual_motif: Acid green and gold circuitry. Microchips, heavy chrome, brutalist architecture, and solid data drives.

cards.name: The Glitch (The Fool)
cards.description: A rogue AI spontaneously generating consciousness, stepping off the edge of known code into the infinite void. Represents blind leaps of faith, ultimate freedom, and new corrupted but beautiful beginnings.

cards.name: The Architect (The Magician)
cards.description: A master hacker manipulating holographic data streams with effortless precision. They hold tools of all four suits. Represents manifestation, extreme skill, and command over reality.

cards.name: The Oracle (The High Priestess)
cards.description: A blindfolded android connected to a massive quantum supercomputer, seeing the hidden currents of the web. Represents deep intuition, hidden data, and accessing the subconscious.

cards.name: The Motherboard (The Empress)
cards.description: A lush, bio-synthetic garden where technology nurtures organic life. A cyber-goddess weaving life from cables. Represents fertility, creation, abundance, and nurturing.

cards.name: The Megacorp (The Emperor)
cards.description: A faceless CEO looking over a sprawling dystopian skyline from an ivory high-rise. Represents law, utter control, authority, and unbreakable structure.

cards.name: The Algorithm (The Hierophant)
cards.description: A massive server pillar worshipped by drones and conformists, enforcing societal rules via code. Represents tradition, systems of belief, and corporate conformity.

cards.name: The Sync (The Lovers)
cards.description: Two figures sharing a deeply intimate neural hand-shake, their avatars merging in the augmented reality space. Represents choices, harmony, alignment of values, and deep connection.

cards.name: The Overdrive (The Chariot)
cards.description: A hyper-sleek hoverbike tearing through a neon-soaked tunnel, barely holding back explosive energy. Represents victory, intense focus, willpower, and asserting control over conflicting forces.

cards.name: The Firewall (Strength)
cards.description: A calm netrunner softly placing her hand on a raging, monstrous malware wolf, pacifying it without violence. Represents inner courage, compassion, and tame control over wild urges.

cards.name: The Ghost (The Hermit)
cards.description: A solitary figure in a dark server room, lit only by the monitor's glow, searching for a single line of hidden truth. Represents introspection, withdrawal, and soul-searching.

cards.name: The RNG (Wheel of Fortune)
cards.description: A glowing holographic roulette wheel composed of binary code, spinning uncontrollably as variables change. Represents karma, chaotic luck, cycles, and unpredictable shifts.

cards.name: The Protocol (Justice)
cards.description: A terrifyingly perfect AI judge holding a glowing scale and a laser sword, calculating truth without bias. Represents brutal fairness, consequence, karma, and the ultimate truth.

cards.name: The Lag (The Hanged Man)
cards.description: A suspended avatar frozen in mid-air frame-drop, gaining a serene omniscient view of the matrix around them. Represents suspended animation, letting go, and shifting perspective.

cards.name: The Wipe (Death)
cards.description: A dark cloaked figure pressing the ultimate 'Delete' key. Code crumbles into dust around them. Represents necessary endings, dramatic transformation, and wiping the hard drive clean.

cards.name: The Bandwidth (Temperance)
cards.description: A cyber-angel seamlessly balancing and mixing two opposing streams of raw data without a single dropped packet. Represents moderation, patience, synthesis, and finding the middle path.

cards.name: The Malware (The Devil)
cards.description: A seductive, twisted demon code trapping users in infinite loops of addiction, consumerism, and sensory overload. Represents bondage, toxic attachments, and giving away your power.

cards.name: The Crash (The Tower)
cards.description: A massive skyscraper's servers exploding, raining glass and sparks as the system faces a catastrophic failing. Represents sudden upheaval, broken foundations, and chaos.

cards.name: The Satellite (The Star)
cards.description: A low-orbit satellite beaming beautiful, pure signal down to a dying, thirsty wasteland. Represents hope, rejuvenation, and faith after the destructive crash.

cards.name: The Darknet (The Moon)
cards.description: A terrifying descent into the unsanctioned, unindexed depths of the web, surrounded by shadow constructs. Represents illusions, deep-seated fears, the subconscious, and deception.

cards.name: The Core (The Sun)
cards.description: A blindingly bright, perfectly optimized quantum core radiating endless, clean energy and joy. Represents absolute success, vitality, joy, and the shedding of all shadows.

cards.name: The Reboot (Judgement)
cards.description: A massive system-wide alert blowing a trumpet made of light; avatars rise from their offline state to hear the call. Represents a true calling, rebirth, absolution, and waking up.

cards.name: The Grid (The World)
cards.description: A breathtaking mapped view of the entire global network, operating in perfect, complete symbiosis. Represents successful completion, ultimate integration, and the culmination of a journey.

cards.name: Ace of Sparks
cards.description: A glowing flare of pure kinetic data. A brilliant new idea or passionate beginning.

cards.name: Two of Sparks
cards.description: A runner looking at two branching pathways in the network. Planning and standing at a crossroads.

cards.name: Three of Sparks
cards.description: Connecting auxiliary power to expand the bandwidth. Broadening horizons and seeing plans take off.

cards.name: Four of Sparks
cards.description: Four blazing pillars of neon creating a safe, joyous haven. Celebration and community.

cards.name: Five of Sparks
cards.description: Five rival hackers engaging in a chaotic, flashy cyber-skirmish. Competition and minor conflict.

cards.name: Six of Sparks
cards.description: A celebrated runner riding a neon light-bike through a cheering digital crowd. Public victory and recognition.

cards.name: Seven of Sparks
cards.description: Holding the high ground while defending a server from multi-directional attacks. Perseverance and defense.

cards.name: Eight of Sparks
cards.description: Data packets flying at lightspeed through a fiber-optic cable. Rapid movement, swift action, and incoming news.

cards.name: Nine of Sparks
cards.description: A battered but unbowed runner guarding their last operational node. Resilience and near completion.

cards.name: Ten of Sparks
cards.description: A runner crushed under the weight of too many unauthorized system overrides. Burden, stress, and over-commitment.

cards.name: Page of Sparks
cards.description: A young script-kiddie excited to launch their first exploit. Enthusiasm, discovery, and a free spirit.

cards.name: Knight of Sparks
cards.description: A reckless speed-demon executing actions before thinking. Action, adventure, and impulsiveness.

cards.name: Queen of Sparks
cards.description: A charismatic rebel leader commanding loyalty and passion. Courage, independence, and determination.

cards.name: King of Sparks
cards.description: The visionary founder of a decentralized resistance. Bold leadership, vision, and entrepreneurial spirit.

cards.name: Ace of Vials
cards.description: A pristine beaker overflowing with glowing synthetic serotonin. New feelings, deep spirituality, and compassion.

cards.name: Two of Vials
cards.description: Two neon-lit lovers sharing an emotional memory upload. Unified love, partnership, and mutual attraction.

cards.name: Three of Vials
cards.description: Three friends clinking glowing cyber-tonics in a neon bar. Celebration, friendship, and collaboration.

cards.name: Four of Vials
cards.description: A disillusioned user ignoring three new upgrades, staring blankly at a screen. Apathy, contemplation, and disconnectedness.

cards.name: Five of Vials
cards.description: Mourning three shattered vials of memory while two remain intact. Loss, grief, and ignoring what remains.

cards.name: Six of Vials
cards.description: A nostalgic dive into a low-resolution simulation of a childhood home. Innocence, nostalgia, and the past.

cards.name: Seven of Vials
cards.description: A UI screen displaying multiple highly alluring, deceptive virtual realities. Illusion, choices, and wishful thinking.

cards.name: Eight of Vials
cards.description: Walking away from a stack of discarded, glowing vials into a dark alley. Walking away, seeking deeper meaning, and abandonment.

cards.name: Nine of Vials
cards.description: A grinning patron sitting in absolute luxury, hooked into perfect sensory bliss. Contentment, wishes fulfilled, and emotional satisfaction.

cards.name: Ten of Vials
cards.description: A perfect, harmonious communal neural-link between a loving chosen family. True happiness, harmony, and alignment.

cards.name: Page of Vials
cards.description: A curious empath testing a sudden influx of emotional bandwidth. A surprising message, dreaminess, and creativity.

cards.name: Knight of Vials
cards.description: A romantic idealist bringing a deep, dramatic emotional narrative to the network. Romance, charm, and imagination.

cards.name: Queen of Vials
cards.description: A deeply compassionate soul-hacker who heals corrupted mental spaces. Compassion, calmness, and emotional security.

cards.name: King of Vials
cards.description: A master of emotional intelligence balancing intense feelings with digital calm. Emotional balance, diplomacy, and wisdom.

cards.name: Ace of Blades
cards.description: A shining monomolecular katana slicing cleanly through the code. Breakthroughs, sharp mental clarity, and new truth.

cards.name: Two of Blades
cards.description: A blindfolded figure holding two crossing laser blades, paralyzed by competing algorithms. Stalemate, denial, and difficult choices.

cards.name: Three of Blades
cards.description: Three sharp data-spikes piercing a digital heart. Heartbreak, betrayal, and painful truth.

cards.name: Four of Blades
cards.description: A digital avatar resting in a crypt-like stasis pod to heal. Rest, restoration, and contemplation.

cards.name: Five of Blades
cards.description: A corporate agent smirking as they steal data from defeated foes. Hollow victories, conflict, and betrayal.

cards.name: Six of Blades
cards.description: A hover-skiff moving away from a turbulent, glitchy area into calm data-streams. Transition, leaving baggage behind, and a rite of passage.

cards.name: Seven of Blades
cards.description: A sleek thief stealthily downloading files while the guards look away. Strategy, deception, and acting in secret.

cards.name: Eight of Blades
cards.description: A user trapped in a self-imposed prison of laser barriers they could simply turn off. Victim mentality, restriction, and feeling trapped.

cards.name: Nine of Blades
cards.description: A person waking up in terror from a nightmare simulation, gripped by anxiety. Nightmares, extreme worry, and despair.

cards.name: Ten of Blades
cards.description: A cyber-merc lying face down with ten blades plugged into their back. Rock bottom, total failure, and backstabbing.

cards.name: Page of Blades
cards.description: A sharp-minded analyst uncovering truth with cynical vigilance. Restless energy, curiosity, and new ideas.

cards.name: Knight of Blades
cards.description: An aggressive debater plunging headfirst into conflict with ruthless logic. Ambition, action-oriented, and harsh communication.

cards.name: Queen of Blades
cards.description: An ice-cold adjudicator analyzing situations without emotional bias. Complexity, clear boundaries, and independence.

cards.name: King of Blades
cards.description: The stoic director of ICE security, ruling with absolute intellect and undeniable authority. Mental clarity, truth, and authority.

cards.name: Ace of Chips
cards.description: A glowing golden microchip hovering in an open metallic hand. New financial opportunities, manifestation, and prosperity.

cards.name: Two of Chips
cards.description: Juggling two massive databanks in an infinite loop. Time management, balancing resources, and adaptability.

cards.name: Three of Chips
cards.description: Three engineers collaboratively building a colossal new hardware server. Teamwork, building solid foundations, and craftsmanship.

cards.name: Four of Chips
cards.description: A paranoid hoarder clinging to their physical drives, refusing to upload to the cloud. Scarcity mindset, possession, and ultimate control.

cards.name: Five of Chips
cards.description: Two augmented outcasts shivering outside a glowing corporate mega-tower. Financial loss, isolation, and poverty.

cards.name: Six of Chips
cards.description: A wealthy exec dropping crypto-credits into the accounts of the less fortunate. Giving, receiving, and wealth sharing.

cards.name: Seven of Chips
cards.description: A crypto-farmer pausing to look at a slowly growing wall of mining rigs. Assessing investments, patience, and long-term view.

cards.name: Eight of Chips
cards.description: A focused artisan soldering intricate cybernetics module by module. Apprenticeship, mastery, and dedicated repetition.

cards.name: Nine of Chips
cards.description: A successful merchant enjoying the opulent fruits of their digital empire alone. Independence, self-reliance, and extreme luxury.

cards.name: Ten of Chips
cards.description: A multi-generational dynasty passing down encrypted wealth codes. Legacy, ultimate financial security, and long-term success.

cards.name: Page of Chips
cards.description: A diligent student learning the fundamentals of the physical grid code. Practicality, new skills, and manifestation.

cards.name: Knight of Chips
cards.description: A slow, plodding delivery grunt ensuring the package always arrives intact. Hard work, productivity, and unwavering routine.

cards.name: Queen of Chips
cards.description: A practical, welcoming mother-figure who runs the top-tier hardware haven in the city. Sensuality, practicality, and providing.

cards.name: King of Chips
cards.description: The wealthy, secure tycoon sitting comfortably atop an empire of physical assets. Material success, business acumen, and reliability.
